results.content:
Limited customisation and branding on lower tiers. The free plan includes Supademo branding on all demos. Even on Pro, branding options are more limited than what Storylane or Navattic offer. Users who need pixel-perfect brand consistency across demos find this frustrating.
 Screenshot-only capture on Pro. HTML capture requires the Scale plan at $38 per creator per month. Teams that need interactive elements beyond click-through screenshots must pay 40% more per seat. Several reviewers mention upgrading solely for HTML capture and feeling the jump is steep for a single feature. [...] ## What Users Complain About [...] Missing integrations that enterprise buyers expect. Supademo integrates with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Slack, but lacks connections to Marketo, Segment, and several other marketing automation platforms. Teams running complex lead scoring or multi-touch attribution find themselves exporting data manually.
 No sandbox or demo environment cloning. Unlike Walnut or Reprise, Supademo does not create a live sandbox of your product. You get screenshots or HTML snapshots, not a functioning copy of your application. For enterprise sales teams running personalised demo environments, this is a non-starter.
